## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, and coverage stays at or above 90%
- [ ] Changes to a critical path (see CONTRIBUTING.md) have a benchmark and a fuzz test
- [ ] API changes started in `api/external/endoflife.yaml`, and `make generate` was run
- [ ] Docs are updated, and `make docs` was run if commands, tools or settings changed
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`)
